scripts.text:
DELETE FROM EDS.RIB_TRANSACTIONHEADER WHERE AS_OF_DATE = CAST(@DatetoProcessed AS DATE);

INSERT INTO EDS.RIB_TRANSACTIONHEADER(
AS_OF_DATE
,BANK_ID
,TXN_ID
,DB_TS
,REQ_ID
,PARENT_REQ_ID
,CORP_ID
,CORP_USER
,TXN_TYPE
,REQUEST_DATE
,TXN_DATE
,TXN_CRN
,TOTAL_TXN_AMT
,TOTAL_TXN_AMT_IN_HOMECRN
,TOTAL_CHARGE_AMT
,TOTAL_AMT
,FREQ_TYPE
,TXN_REF_NAME
,PMT_FREQ
,TOT_NO_OF_INSTANCES
,VALIDITY_INDICATOR
,NO_OF_INSTANCES_PROCESSED
,FILE_GEN_NUM
,FILE_UPLOAD_NUM
,BATCH_TYPE
,HOLD_FLG
,TOTAL_NO_OF_ENTRIES
,HIGHEST_ENTRY_AMOUNT
,HIGHEST_ENTRY_SRL_NO
,DRCR_FLG
,TXN_STATUS
,TMPL_ID
,TMPL_DISPLAY_ID
,USER_ACTION_REMRAKS
,ENTERER_ID
,APPROVAL_HISTORY
,ACCOUNTS_USED
,DEL_FLG
,BULK_PMT_REF_NUM
,FU_REC_NUM
,R_CRE_ID
,R_CRE_TIME
,R_MOD_ID
,R_MOD_TIME
,isActive
,isLatest
,BNK_CODE
,SOURCE_CODE
,FILE_NAME
,insert_dttm
)
SELECT 
@DatetoProcessed AS AS_OF_DATE
,BANK_ID
,TXN_ID
,DB_TS
,REQ_ID
,PARENT_REQ_ID
,CORP_ID
,CORP_USER
,TXN_TYPE
,REQUEST_DATE
,TXN_DATE
,TXN_CRN
,TOTAL_TXN_AMT
,TOTAL_TXN_AMT_IN_HOMECRN
,TOTAL_CHARGE_AMT
,TOTAL_AMT
,FREQ_TYPE
,TXN_REF_NAME
,PMT_FREQ
,TOT_NO_OF_INSTANCES
,VALIDITY_INDICATOR
,NO_OF_INSTANCES_PROCESSED
,FILE_GEN_NUM
,FILE_UPLOAD_NUM
,BATCH_TYPE
,HOLD_FLG
,TOTAL_NO_OF_ENTRIES
,HIGHEST_ENTRY_AMOUNT
,HIGHEST_ENTRY_SRL_NO
,DRCR_FLG
,TXN_STATUS
,TMPL_ID
,TMPL_DISPLAY_ID
,USER_ACTION_REMRAKS
,ENTERER_ID
,APPROVAL_HISTORY
,ACCOUNTS_USED
,DEL_FLG
,BULK_PMT_REF_NUM
,FU_REC_NUM
,R_CRE_ID
,R_CRE_TIME
,R_MOD_ID
,R_MOD_TIME
,1 as isActive
,1 as isLatest
,left(FILE_NAME, 5) as BNK_CODE
,substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as SOURCE_CODE
,FILE_NAME
,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS DATETIME) as insert_dttm
FROM D360.STG_EDS_RIB_TRANSACTIONHEADER
WHERE H = 'D'
